name: Choose Recovery Code Rotation
summary: An authenticated user with TOTP enabled chooses to rotate recovery codes and is shown an explicit confirmation surface before any server mutation occurs.

preconditions.expression: user is authenticated and TOTP is enabled

serverInteraction.intent: Navigate to the recovery-code rotation confirmation surface without changing the current recovery-code set.

postconditions.expression: TOTP remains enabled and the current recovery-code set remains unchanged
